methodology: Incremental regression over the same 59-read-only inventory from Issue #115. The Issue #121 production diff changes only operations summary/admin read behavior; the other 56 ability callback paths are unchanged. The three affected callbacks were re-evaluated against the patched call graph, the actual-service CI contract, live existing-plan before/after domain fingerprints, and a guarded missing-plan production smoke that blocks domain writes before SQL.
scope_notes: The three former operations SIDE_EFFECT_DOMAIN abilities are now SAFE in callback scope because summary() no longer calls ensure_plan().
The existing 8 SIDE_EFFECT_TECHNICAL classifications are unchanged and represent cache/transient warming, not operations domain state.
Explicit operations initialize/create/update/schedule/resource write paths still call ensure_plan() where appropriate and are outside the read-only classification.
Admin Operations GET/render was separately corrected to use get_plan(); missing plans expose an explicit POST initialize action.
Background cron/concurrent third-party hooks remain outside the guarded callback boundary; targeted production fingerprints and SQL-write guard cover the Issue #121 domain tables.
